clauses.title: Compensation
clauses.text: Your annual cost to company (CTC) will be Rs. 9,00,000, paid monthly, with the breakdown attached as Annexure A.
clauses.simple: You will be paid a total of Rs. 9,00,000 per year, paid in monthly installments.

clauses.title: Probation
clauses.text: You will be on probation for 6 months, after which your employment will be confirmed subject to satisfactory performance.
clauses.simple: You will have a 6-month trial period to show you can do the job well.

clauses.title: Working Hours
clauses.text: You will work 6 days a week, 10 hours a day. No overtime will be paid for additional hours.
clauses.simple: You will work 10 hours a day, 6 days a week, and won't get extra money for working more.
clauses.reason: 60 hours a week with no overtime pay is unusual.

clauses.title: Leave
clauses.text: You are entitled to 18 days of paid leave per year, in addition to public holidays.
clauses.simple: You get 18 paid days off every year plus public holidays.

clauses.title: Training Bond
clauses.text: If you leave the Company within 2 years of joining for any reason, you shall pay the Company Rs. 3,00,000 as liquidated damages towards training.
clauses.simple: If you quit before 2 years, you must pay the company Rs. 3,00,000.
clauses.reason: A fixed 3,00,000 penalty for leaving within 2 years is unusual.

clauses.title: Notice Period
clauses.text: You must give 90 days' written notice to resign. The Company may terminate your employment with 7 days' notice.
clauses.simple: You must tell the company 90 days before quitting, but they only have to tell you 7 days before letting you go.
clauses.reason: Employer notice of 7 days is much less than your 90 days.

clauses.title: Final Settlement
clauses.text: Your full and final settlement will be processed within 90 days of your exit. If the full notice period is not served, the Company may withhold your last month's salary.
clauses.simple: You will get your final pay within 90 days of leaving, but they might keep your last month's pay if you don't give enough notice.
clauses.reason: Withholding last month's salary is against the law.

clauses.title: Intellectual Property
clauses.text: All inventions, code and creative works made by you during your employment, whether or not during working hours or using Company resources, shall belong to the Company.
clauses.simple: Anything you create or code while working here belongs to the company.
clauses.reason: Claiming inventions made outside working hours is unusual.

clauses.title: Non-Compete
clauses.text: For 2 years after leaving the Company, you shall not join or work for any competitor or client of the Company in India.
clauses.simple: For 2 years after you leave, you cannot work for the company's competitors or clients in India.
clauses.reason: A 2-year post-employment non-compete is against the law.

clauses.title: Changes To Terms
clauses.text: The Company may change your salary, role, or work location at its sole discretion.
clauses.simple: The company can change your pay, job, or where you work whenever they want.
clauses.reason: Changing salary or role at sole discretion is unusual.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: You shall keep the Company's confidential information secret during and after your employment.
clauses.simple: You must keep the company's private information a secret even after you stop working there.

Clause 3 vs E7 (Working hours and overtime): 60 hours a week with no overtime pay is unusual.

Clause 7 vs E4 (Wages can't be withheld): Withholding last month's salary is against the law.
Clause 8 vs E5 (IP limited to the job): Claiming inventions made outside working hours is unusual.
Clause 9 vs E1 (No post-exit non-compete): A 2-year post-employment non-compete is against the law.
